steps.title: Add library mix to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL of 4X rhAmpSeq Library Mix 2 from slot 2, column 1 into each 30 µL sample located in slot 1 on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add indexing primer mixes
steps.instruction: Dispense 4 µL of the appropriate indexing primer mix from slot 4 into each sample in slot 1 on the magnetic module, ensuring each sample receives its unique i5/i7 primer combination.

steps.title: Signal protocol completion
steps.instruction: Observe the OT‑2 robot lights flashing on and off to indicate the protocol has finished.
